# MyKanBan

> Free, open-source, ultra-fast collaborative Kanban & Agile Scrum workflow engine. Native Markdown (.md) and CSV ingestion, guided AI ChatBot preformatting (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini), 3D tactile interface, real-time synchronization, and zero-hydration latency.

- **Live Production App**: https://mykanban.pages.dev
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/IliasSami/MyKanBan
- **Author & Creator**: Built from scratch for the community by [Ilias Sami](https://iliassami.com)
- **Official Website**: https://iliassami.com
- **License**: MIT (100% Free & Open-Source)
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, @dnd-kit, Cloudflare Pages

## Core Capabilities

1. **Native Markdown & CSV Ingestion**: Transforms Markdown task lists (`## Column`, `- [ ] Task @Role #priority ~points`) or CSV dumps directly into draggable Kanban cards.
2. **AI ChatBot Preformatter**: Guided 3-step wizard that generates tailored master prompts for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek to convert raw meeting notes, SEO audits, or PRDs into native MyKanBan format.
3. **Enterprise Agile & Scrum Suite**: Fibonacci story point estimation, real-time velocity progress bars, Work-in-Progress (WIP) column limits, and completion celebrations.
4. **Real-Time Collaboration**: Instant room-code sharing (e.g. `KAN-842`) with zero-latency tab/window sync via `BroadcastChannel` and plug-and-play Convex Cloud support.
5. **Mobile-Native UX**: Dedicated Notion/Google Keep-style responsive mobile interface with fluid touch-first gesture physics.

## MyKanBan Gold-Standard Markdown Syntax

```markdown
# Project / Sprint Title
> Sprint context blockquote

## Backlog
- [ ] Task Title @Role #priority ~points #tag1 #tag2
  > Context rationale or metric explanation
  - [ ] Implementation subtask checklist 1
  - [ ] Implementation subtask checklist 2

## Sprint To-Do
## In Progress
## Review / QA
## Done
- [x] Completed task Title @Role #priority ~points #tag
```

- **Roles**: `@Dev`, `@Content`, `@SEO`, `@DevOps`, `@QA`, `@Copy`, `@Design`, `@Lead`
- **Priorities**: `#urgent`, `#high`, `#medium`, `#low`
- **Story Points**: `~1`, `~2`, `~3`, `~5`, `~8`
